facts.fact: The national social registry exchanges data with 27 government databases through the national ID number to verify data and sharpen targeting, per the Ministry of Social Solidarity's Raafat Shafik.

Takaful and Karama, the conditional cash transfer programme, runs on an integrated software system that verifies applicants' socio-economic data, per the Ministry of Social Solidarity's Raafat Shafik.
The national social registry holds data on 13 million households, about half of Egypt's, per the Ministry of Social Solidarity's Raafat Shafik.
The social registry is linked to 27 government databases through the national ID number, per Raafat Shafik of the Ministry of Social Solidarity.
